summary: The Request handling section states that each request carries an idempotency key so retried transfers do not post twice. The rest of the section is a repeated list of operational assertions: 200 ms p95 read latency target, low-priority backfills, alerts paging after five minutes, health and readiness endpoints, structured logs per write, unit test coverage, ninety-day secret rotation, schema review for index impact, single YAML config, per-region dashboards, and a three-phase migration with no downtime. No evidence supports any assertion.

claims.text: Each request carries an idempotency key so a retried transfer does not post twice.
Read latency target is under 200 ms at the 95th percentile.
Alerts route to the payments channel and page after five minutes.
Secrets rotate every ninety days through the platform vault.
The migration ran in three phases over two weekends without downtime.
Configuration lives in a single YAML file loaded at startup.

risks.note: 200 ms p95 target and five-minute page delay stated with no measurement or source.
Migration claimed complete without downtime; no dates, metrics, or reference given.
Sentences repeat verbatim across paragraphs; text reads as padding, not design content.

least_confident: I could not tell whether the heavy sentence repetition is intentional filler or a corrupted draft, and no sentence in the chunk carries supporting evidence.
